en: Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town in a hilly landscape. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with twin spires and a large nave, surrounded by clustered village houses and a few larger buildings. The foreground shows sloping fields and farmhouses on a hillside. The sky area at the top is blank except for red printed German text on the left and a red handwritten note or date on the right.
